verdict.rationale: Pendo documents an official JavaScript install for web apps and a mobile SDK. Its public developer APIs cover Native Android, Native iOS, React Native, Flutter and Xamarin. Track Events with properties can be sent from front-end JavaScript or as REST API calls, but backend events go through raw REST only, with no evidence of official server-side SDKs. missing for 10: official backend-language SDKs (e.g. Node, Python, Java, Go, Ruby), explicit SDK-level event-tracking docs for mobile, independent or hands-on corroboration.
